## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND channel = 'store') > 1 THEN (SELECT AVG(ext_discount_amt) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND channel = 'store') ELSE (SELECT AVG(net_paid) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 AND channel = 'store') END AS bucket1, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 AND channel = 'store') > 1 THEN (SELECT AVG(ext_discount_amt) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 AND channel = 'store') ELSE (SELECT AVG(net_paid) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 AND channel = 'store') END AS bucket2, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 AND channel = 'store') > 1 THEN (SELECT AVG(ext_discount_amt) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 AND channel = 'store') ELSE (SELECT AVG(net_paid) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 AND channel = 'store') END AS bucket3, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 AND channel = 'store') > 1 THEN (SELECT AVG(ext_discount_amt) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 AND channel = 'store') ELSE (SELECT AVG(net_paid) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 AND channel = 'store') END AS bucket4, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND channel = 'store') > 1 THEN (SELECT AVG(ext_discount_amt) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND channel = 'store') ELSE (SELECT AVG(net_paid) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 AND channel = 'store') END AS bucket5 FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE reason_r_reason_sk = 1 AND channel = 'store'
```
